footer.tagline: An Egyptian streaming platform celebrating Arab and world cinema.
footer.disclaimer: Farja is a discovery and streaming guide; it does not host video files. Content plays through third-party servers and all rights belong to their owners. Film and series metadata comes from TMDB.

about.title: About Farja
about.subtitle: Our story with cinema, from Cairo to the world.
about.intro: Farja is an Egyptian streaming platform bringing together the best of Arabic cinema and TV drama alongside curated world titles in one elegant, easy viewing experience.
about.mission: Make discovery and watching delightful: Arabic-first design, speed and clarity, without friction or intrusive ads in the core experience.
about.feature1: Thousands of films and series with live TMDB metadata.
about.feature2: Multiple streaming servers for every title, so playback keeps working.
about.feature3: Watchlist, history and resume-watching synced across your devices.
about.feature4: Full Arabic/English support with RTL and LTR layouts.
about.tech: Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma & PostgreSQL, NextAuth and the TMDB API — ready to deploy on Vercel.
about.contactBody: Questions or feedback? Email us at {email}.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: We respect your privacy and protect your data. This page explains what we collect and how we use it.
privacy.dataBody: When you create an account we store your name, email and a bcrypt-hashed password. We also store your watchlist and watch history to provide the service.
privacy.cookiesBody: We use a secure session cookie (JWT) and remember your language and theme preferences. We do not use advertising trackers.
privacy.thirdPartyBody: We use TMDB for metadata and third-party video players that handle data under their own policies. We do not host video files.
privacy.rightsBody: You can update your details or permanently delete your account and data from your account page at any time.
privacy.contactBody: For privacy questions, email us at {email}.
